comment: The README says a circle button plays the major triad of the mode and root scale; ModeScaleQuant.cpp reads that position's own chordType, so the chord is major, minor or diminished depending on the degree, and the line says so. The gate and mode outputs have no configOutput call, so Rack shows no tooltip for them. The poly scale output has no family because the menu changes it between 1V/octave pitches and a chromatic 8V/10V marker map.
